referenceSources.description:
A striking yellow Porsche 996 GT3 R, chassis number WP0ZZZ99ZYS692090, stands in a spacious garage. The car’s livery features bold sponsor logos—Castrol, Penders Porsche Centre Liège, Derbigum, LUK, Air Liquide—and the race number 80 from the 24 Heures du Mans 2000. Its aerodynamic bodywork includes a large rear wing, front splitter, and racing slicks.

Originally built for Le Mans competition, this GT3 R first ran Belcar events before contesting the 2000 24 Hours of Le Mans with drivers P. Verellen, R. Penders, and K. Dujardin. Subsequent upgrades included a 3.9L RSR engine and sequential gearbox, and a full restoration in 2016 returned it to its original specification. The sale package includes extensive documentation, homologation papers, and technical passports.
